_doc.summary: Shape of synthetic demand. Volumes, seed and dates live in .env; everything else the generator draws from is here. All weights are relative (they need not sum to 1). Hours are local Dubai time, 0-23.
_doc.weekday_multipliers: Mon..Sun -> multiplier on the .env daily volume (A14).
_doc.geo.max_resample: Draws allowed when placing a point on land in its area's emirate before the generator gives up (see service_area.geojson).
_doc.volume_noise_sd_factor: Daily count = round(gauss(mean, factor * sqrt(mean))), floored at 0.
_doc.booking_hours: [first, last) hour of day when routine bookings are made, on the booking day.
_doc.drivers.shifts: Per fleet home_vertical: contracted shift start HH:MM and length in hours (A5).
_doc.staff.work_days_per_week: Days each nurse/babysitter works; the rest days are drawn from rest_day_weights.
_doc.clients.primary_mix: Share of clients whose main service is each vertical; the area is drawn from that vertical's weight in areas.csv.
_doc.clients.second_service_prob: Chance a client also uses one other vertical.
_doc.clients.villa_share_by_area: area_id -> probability a client there lives in a villa (area-type heuristic); other areas use villa_share_default.
_doc.clients.access_notes: Per building_type: access note -> weight. Empty string means no note.
_doc.verticals.<v>.bookings: nursing/babysitting: list of booking kinds. Each has weight, start_hour_weights, start_minute_weights, duration_h_weights, optional latest_end_hour (end must not pass this hour, counted from the start day's midnight, 24 = midnight), dropoff_share and pickup_share (A7), and an optional fixed note.
_doc.verticals.<v>.lead_time_days: Days before service date the routine booking is made -> weight.
_doc.verticals.<v>.cancel_rate / no_show_rate: Probabilities per booking. cancelled_at falls between booked_at and start.
_doc.verticals.<v>.staff_turnaround_min: Minutes a staff member is blocked after a booking ends before the next can start (nursing: minimum rest between shifts).
_doc.verticals.<v>.staff_max_concurrent: Most bookings one staff member may hold over overlapping windows. 1 for nursing and babysitting; sample windows are 1-hour slots with a 10-20 minute visit, so a collection nurse can cover more than one per slot.
_doc.verticals.<v>.notes: Free-text ops note -> weight. Empty string means no note.
_doc.verticals.sample.slot_hour_weights: Routine collection slot start hour -> weight (A9). Slots last slot_min.
_doc.verticals.sample.service_min: [min, max] minutes on site for a collection.
_doc.verticals.sample.tests: Test type -> weight, sample_max_min (A10: minutes from collection to lab), fasting, keep_cold (needs the cool box). The lab is always the nearest lab by distance, computed, not stored.
_doc.verticals.sample.fasting_latest_slot_hou: Fasting tests only go in slots starting at or before this hour.
_doc.verticals.sample.slot_search_max_shift_h: If no collection nurse is free in the requested slot, the booking is offered up to this many hours earlier or later before it is declined.
_doc.verticals.sample.fast_track: share of collections that are same-day fast-tracks (A11), notice_min [min, max], start_hour_weights and start_minute_weights for their start (06:00-22:00 window).
_doc.fleet_events: Per active car per day, at most one event. breakdown: rate, out_for_day_share, repair_h [min, max], at drawn inside the driver's shift. late_start: rate, delay_min [min, max], ops learns notice_min [min, max] before shift start. driver_absent: rate, notice_min [min, max] before shift start; car out for the day.
